messages:
tara: Quick postmortem follow-up. We verified a late-ingest window on 2026-03-12 02:0004:20 UTC due to a consumer stall. Impact: ~2k accounts saw delayed token counts that hit invoices after cutoff. Need concrete owners for: replay/backfill, canonical counts, invoice edits, and customer comms.

ben: I'll take replay/backfill. Plan: apply GC tuning + bump consumer replicas, then run replay with safe rate-limits. Proposed start: 08:00 UTC tomorrow. ETA for full backlog ~5-8h depending on parallelism. I'll publish a runbook and a preflight checklist.

olivia: I'll own invoice edits and support comms. To do: get canonical corrected token CSV mapped to invoice_id, calculate credits, and stage invoice reissues in batches. Prefer to hold reissues for 2460h after counts to avoid churn.

raj: I'll own infra follow-ups. Seeing this on smaller instance types under sustained GC pressure. I'll open infra ticket (infra-859) for host sizing + JVM flags audit and add monthly GC-pressure sweep.

billing-bot: BillingTicketCreated: BILL-5022 created and assigned to olivia for invoice reissue work.

tara: Action list I captured: 1) ben 00 apply consumer fix + run replay (kickoff 08:00 UTC) 2) olivia 00 produce CSV: account_id, invoice_id, old_tokens, corrected_tokens, credit_cents, note 3) raj 00 infra sizing + monthly check 4) tara 00 exec update and track closure in postmortem tracker.

ben: Replay verification step: run sampling queries to ensure no double-counting. Example query for verification sample:
```
-- sample verification
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) AS replay_tokens
FROM metering.events_replayed
WHERE replay_window = '2026-03-12T02:00:00Z/2026-03-12T04:20:00Z'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY replay_tokens DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
I'll attach diffs vs original ingest and a checksum file to the run artifacts.

olivia: CSV format confirmed. Support wants tag `late-ingest-2026-03-12` and batching size 250 invoices per reissue job. Also request a human review for accounts with credit > $200.

raj: I'll add an alert to platform: `metering.consumer_lag > 15m` -> oncall page + automatic escalation. Also add a deploy-time check so replay cannot start unless consumer parallelism >= 4 and disk free > 20%.

tara: Policy change proposal: any ingestion lag > 1h in billing window should be flagged `billing_review` to exclude from automated cutoff. Then ledger replay will clear the flag. Agree? @ben @olivia

ben: Agree. I'll add a `pending_replay` tag to ledger rows and make replay idempotent.

olivia: Agree. We'll also make support templates and store draft in /docs/billing/late-ingest-templates.md.

runbook-bot: RunbookPublished: /runbooks/replay-2026-03-12 created by ben.

tara: Next steps: ben posts runbook link and preflight checklist here, olivia will prepare csv template and comms draft, raj files infra ticket. I'll mark owners in the tracker and do a 48h SLA check after replay completes. Escalation path: CS ops -> legal if reissues slip beyond 72h. Thanks :thumbsup:
